name: genomicschain_prov
description: GenomicsChain service (2.5) provenance anchoring: writes a provenance bundle (BioCompute Object IEEE 2791-2020) from a computation's stages or fills in one a pipeline wrote thin, reads it back into the seven recorded conditions, grades pin strength with the Tier-2 six levels, records it on the anchor as a signed Tier-2.5 proof when it grades immutable (with optional ZK receipts verified and linked to their steps), and checks a bundle against its anchor proof. The bundle stays with the customer.
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
